literature_notes: All seven ledger lines (L1–L7) describe a single construct: full-length human L-selectin with a V5-His tag appended to the intracellular carboxy terminus (residue 372). L2 states this explicitly ('V5-His tag at the intracellular carboxy terminus') and L3 confirms it ('C-terminal tagging of L-selectin with the V5-His tag'). L-selectin is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein; its C-terminus (residues 356–372) is cytoplasmic, so this tag is not on the extracellular face. The GFP fusion mentioned in L1 ('L-selectin-GFP') has no residue stated and, given the naming convention and topology, would also be a C-terminal intracellular fusion. No ledger line reports any tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon insertion, or domain insertion on the extracellular domain (residues 29–333) or at the mature N-terminus (after residue 28). The rules forbid proposing sites not grounded in the ledger, so sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: V5-His tag placed after the final residue (Y372) at the intracellular carboxy terminus; explicitly described as cytoplasmic in L2 and confirmed functional (ADAM17-mediated ectodomain shedding preserved, L3/L5).
